api.description: Identifier of the native surface this build serves.

feature_tokens.description: Versioned capability tokens a client matches against.

identity_schema.description: Version of the server/organization/account/profile identity model.

media_types.description: The item types this build can serve.

delegated_admin_roles.description: Administration can be delegated below the server owner.

direct_profile_login.description: A profile can hold its own credentials rather than logging in through its account.

legacy_silo_v1.description: This build still answers Silo's frozen /api/v1 surface.

shared_device_pairing.description: A device can be paired to a household rather than to one account.

tenant_bounded_media_scope.description: Media visibility is bounded by the viewer's organization.

read_cutoff.description: Opaque boundary this traversal was taken against.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last one.

initial_snapshot.description: True when no cursor was sent, so this page is the newest snapshot rather than a replayed gap.

items.description: Rows newer than the cursor, oldest first.

unread_count.description: Unread rows across the whole inbox, not just this page.

default.description: True for the organization a client should select when the viewer has not chosen one.

membership_id.description: The membership granting this account access.

policy_revision.description: Increments when this organization's access policy changes.

security_revision.description: Increments when credentials or sessions are invalidated.

filmography.description: Credits filtered to what this viewer may see.

kind.description: The item's kind, not the credit's.

api_versions.description: Silo-compatible API majors this build serves.

server_id.description: Stable identity of this installation. A client keys stored scope by it, so it survives renames and address changes.

server_name.description: Display name, which may change at any time. Never use it as an identity.

setup_complete.description: False while the server has no owner account, which is the only state where the setup routes answer.

status.description: "ok" when the server can answer, or a reason it cannot.

duration.description: Total runtime in seconds, as the client observed it.

force_overwrite.description: Replace a newer server-side position rather than losing to it.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 time the client recorded this position. Omit for a live update.

error.description: Why this item was not applied, when it was not.

detail.description: Safe occurrence-specific explanation; not for control flow
examples: The request did not pass validation; see errors.

instance.description: urn:silo:request:<request-id>, matching the X-Request-ID response header

status.description: HTTP status code, equal to the response status

title.description: Short summary fixed for the problem type

type.description: Stable problem type URI; the final segment is the problem identifier

code.description: Stable machine-readable code for the failure

detail.description: Safe human-readable explanation; never the rejected value
examples: expected required property name to be present

location.description: Where the error occurred: body.*, query.*, path.* or header.*

bearerAuth.description: A session token or an API key in the Authorization header. The server decides which it holds.

info.description: Bloem's own surface: features Silo does not have and will not gain, plus the tenancy and entitlement model Bloem adds on top of it.
info.title: Bloem Native API
